remarks: One of a kind! You will fall in love with this completely renovated one bedroom, located in the heart of Stamford. The new, stylish and sleek, gourmet kitchen, includes GE cafe appliances and farm sink as well as a coffee and breakfast bar. There is hardwood throughout, recessed lighting, ceiling fans, and all new windows in this elevated first floor unit. Bedroom is outfitted with an Elf closet system, allowing for great storage and organization. Enjoy cozy nights in the living room with its fireplace TV stand. This wonderful downtown location offers plenty of off-street parking, a short walk to Scalzi park, shops, restaurants and more. Good credit a must.
